# Rayon Lab Tech

Manufacturer of premium modular laboratory furniture, fume hoods, anti-vibration tables, exhaust systems, and laboratory workstations based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Facts
- Company: Rayon Lab Tech
- City: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Address: 74 - Dev Aditya Industrial Park, Bakrol - Dhamatvan Rd, Daskroi, Gujarat 382430
- Phone: +91 9909030607
- Email: Rltsales@rayonlabtech.in

## Products & Capabilities
- Modular Laboratory Furniture & Island Tables
- Chemical & Ducted Laboratory Fume Hoods
- Anti-Vibration Tables for Precision Instruments
- Fume Spot Extractors & Centrifugal Exhaust Blowers
- Stainless Steel (SS 304/316) Lab Furniture & Sinks
- Chemical Storage & Glassware Cabinets
